candidate.title: FiT-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned FiT-seq middle row: fixed-tissue chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing from FFPE-fixed chromatin through pre-sonication proteinase K treatment, antibody selection and purified DNA. The card title and the matching secondary page identify this row as the target. The adjacent MAINE-Seq/MNase-Seq/Nucleo-Seq and PAT-ChIP rows, and clipped labels at the top, are independent context, with no connecting arrows to FiT-seq. This is one serial route, with no depicted alternative branch, split or pooling. The left yellow/grey chromatin cartoon identifies the method; it does not establish a separate fixation operation. The schematic ends at DNA: its antibody-selected genomic fragments provide the carrier for a downstream histone-mark sequencing library, whose construction is unshown. Treatment icons for SDS/proteinase K are components of their local operations, not independent material branches. No DNA end groups, adapter structures, barcodes or explicit strand chemistry are shown.
